name: Barley
notes: Barley requires approximately 25mm of rainfall or irrigation at seeding to ensure good germination and establishment. Plant April-June in the Overberg winter rainfall region. Soil moisture should reach 30cm depth.

name: Oats
notes: Oats require approximately 30mm of rainfall or irrigation at seeding to ensure good germination and establishment. Plant April-June in the Overberg winter rainfall region. Oats are slightly more water demanding than barley at establishment.
